storefront.title: Áruházi felület
storefront.empty.heading: Amit a látogatók látnak
storefront.empty.body: Válassza ki, hogy a kiskereskedelmi látogatók lássák-e az árakat, egy bejelentkezésre vagy jelentkezésre felkérő üzenetet lássanak, vagy egyáltalán ne tudjanak fizetni.
storefront.errors.heading: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem before saving} other {Fix # problems before saving}}
storefront.saved.syncLater: Saved. Your storefront will update within an hour.
storefront.embed.heading: Tradepass app embed
storefront.embed.activeBody: The app embed is on in your published theme, so access settings and the Apply button work.
storefront.embed.inactiveBody: Turn on the Tradepass app embed in your theme. Without it, prices stay visible to everyone and the Apply banner doesn't show.
storefront.mode.heading: Who sees prices
storefront.mode.label: Access mode
storefront.mode.showDetails: Retail visitors shop as usual. You can show a "Buying for a business? Apply for wholesale" banner.
storefront.mode.hideDetails: Prices and Add to cart are replaced with a message and Log in and Apply buttons, on the whole store or only where you choose.
storefront.mode.wholesaleOnlyDetails: Everything in the option above, plus checkout is blocked for anyone who isn't buying for an approved company.
storefront.mode.visualNote: Hiding prices is visual: someone with a direct link could still reach checkout. Only the wholesale-only store blocks non-wholesale orders at checkout.
storefront.mode.noB2b: Your Shopify plan doesn't include B2B, so no one could check out in wholesale-only mode. Check your plan on Home before turning this on.
storefront.mode.buyersNote: Approved wholesale buyers who are logged in always see their prices, even while changes are being published.
storefront.scope.label: Hide prices on
storefront.scope.tagsHelp: Separate tags with commas, for example: trade-only, bulk
storefront.wall.pagesLabel: Pages and collections for wholesale customers only (optional)
storefront.wall.pagesHelp: Enter handles separated by commas, for example: price-list, trade-catalog. Other visitors see the Log in and Apply message instead.
storefront.wall.exemptLabel: Customer tags that may still check out (optional)
storefront.wall.exemptHelp: For example staff or retail accounts you create draft orders for. Separate tags with commas.
storefront.links.heading: Buttons and links
storefront.links.applyHelp: The page with your application form, for example /pages/wholesale.
storefront.links.loginHelp: Usually /account/login. Buyers come back to the page they were on.
storefront.links.banner: Show "Apply for wholesale" banner to retail visitors
storefront.links.bannerHelp: A small banner at the top of your store's pages.
storefront.links.hint: Show wholesale price hint to retail visitors
storefront.links.hintHelp: Adds a short line under product prices saying wholesale pricing is available.
storefront.colors.inherit: Leave empty to use your theme's colours.
storefront.texts.heading: Messages and button labels
storefront.texts.body: Edit what visitors see in each language. Empty fields use Tradepass's built-in translation, shown in grey.
storefront.texts.checkoutDefault: This store sells to approved wholesale customers only. Log in or apply for an account.
storefront.preview.heading: Preview as
storefront.preview.customerNote: Has a customer account but isn't an approved wholesale buyer.
storefront.preview.wholesaleNoTier: Approved buyer. Create a tier to preview its prices.
storefront.preview.checkoutNote: In wholesale-only mode, checkout also shows your checkout message to anyone not buying for an approved company.
storefront.preview.unavailableBody: Save your settings and check your store directly.
storefront.advanced.heading: Custom selectors (advanced)
storefront.advanced.body: Only needed if your theme hides prices incorrectly. Enter CSS selectors, separated by commas; they're added to Tradepass's built-in ones.
storefront.uninstall.heading: If you uninstall Tradepass
storefront.uninstall.body: Price hiding and the checkout lock stop straight away, and nothing is left in your theme. Companies, B2B catalogs and buyers you approved stay in Shopify.
storefront.confirm.onBody: After you save, only customers buying for an approved company can check out. Retail visitors and customers without a company will see your checkout message instead.
storefront.confirm.offBody: Your store will be open to everyone after you save: anyone can check out, and the checkout lock is removed.
storefront.confirm.saveNote: Nothing changes on your store until you save.
storefront.error.scopeEmpty: Choose at least one item, or hide prices on the whole store.
storefront.error.scopeIds: Some chosen items couldn't be read. Choose them again.
storefront.error.tag: Tags can't contain commas or angle brackets.
storefront.error.url: Enter a web address starting with https:// or a store path starting with /.
storefront.error.color: Enter a colour like #1a1a1a, or leave it empty to use your theme's colour.
storefront.error.selector: Selectors can't contain curly brackets, angle brackets, semicolons, @ signs or backslashes.
storefront.error.handle: Handles can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
storefront.error.text: This text is too long. Use up to {max} characters.
